fields.quoted_span: In order to evict a tenant from a rental unit covered by the Rent Ordinance, a landlord must have a "just cause" reason that is the dominant motive for pursuing the eviction.
fields.note: The document supports the 17 just causes, the dominant-motive rule, the expiration/ownership-change point, housing-service removal and the § 37.2(r) soft-story exception. It says nothing about § 37.9C or § 37.9A relocation payments, the March 1 adjustment, or Civ. Code § 1947.9.
